notes: Genubar v0.1.0 initial release — Global menu bar daemon, GNOME Shell extension, GTK4 hook, Patch/Profile engine, and Settings app.
changelog: Native GNOME top panel global menu integration across GTK3, GTK4, Electron, Qt, and AT-SPI2 backends
Application Patch & Profile system with live state bindings and menu normalization
Bundle, Style CSS, and Icon Pack customization UI with Settings Manager
Forward-compatible v0.1 configuration, patch, and registry schemas
Fixed GNOME Shell extension startup on Ubuntu desktop session mode ('ubuntu')
Added automated CI testing and release packaging workflow
